0.reason: an OSError reading the partner's pointer propagates and stops the promotion, which fails closed: no paired arm lands while its partner's state is unreadable; the docstring's wording is the only inaccuracy

findings.text: follow-on: _partner_phase only catches CrewError, so its docstring's promise that a present-but-unreadable pointer is read as unreadable holds for malformed JSON but not for an OSError from path.read_text (for example EACCES), which would propagate out of the promotion instead of being read as non-terminal.
